messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need final sign-off for the GA entrance criteria for Launch X by EOD. Main concerns: SLA targets, docs + runbooks, oncall coverage, monitoring dashboards, and pricing/quota mapping. TL;DR: propose P99 latency <= 300ms hosted, availability >= 99.9%, canary + smoke pass, billing smoke test.

Zane (SRE): Can we clarify if P99 300ms applies to 1-token median traffic or to customer tail (longer seqs)?

Maya (PM): Good q. Apply to 95th percentile of request size for initial rollout (<= 512 tokens). We'll add a note: longer sequences are Best Effort and listed in docs.

Priya (Eng): Dashboards: perf dashboard is wired to prod metrics (p50/p95/p99, error-rate, kv-cache hit). Canary job is green on staging. Need someone to confirm alert thresholds and run a live canary before handoff.

Zane (SRE): I can validate alerts. Proposed alert buckets:
- perf_p99 > 300ms for 5m -> Sev2
- error_rate > 1% for 5m -> Sev1
- availability < 99.9% for 30m -> Exec page
(agree?)

Diego (FinOps): Pricing/billing: we still need the quota->rate card mapping for pilot customers. Also request a billing smoke test flow: create org, run 1000 tokens, invoice event emitted. Who owns the test?

Maya (PM): Owners: Zane -> alerts + oncall rotation entries; Priya -> final canary + docs snippet for smoke test; Diego -> billing mapping and smoke test validation. I'll coordinate the signoff doc.

Priya (Eng): I'll add a small smoke script to the runbook:
```bash
# smoke test - generation endpoint
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-v1", "input":"hello"}' | jq .status
```
Will run it against canary and prod after deploy.

Diego (FinOps): I'll put together test org creds and run the billing flow. Expecting invoice event name: invoice.generated.v1. Will post results here.

Zane (SRE): Oncall rotation: need 2 weeks overlap between release and steady-state. Can we confirm who covers the first 72h? @Maya assign?

Maya (PM): Recommend: Priya + Zane primary for first 72h, then hand to platform oncall team. I'll update the oncall calendar.

OncallBot: Reminder — runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/launch-x (canary checklist included).

Priya (Eng): Docs: I'll add a dedicated section "Launch X GA expectations" with the SLA table, known limitations (long sequences), and a step-by-step smoke test. ETA: 6 hours.

Diego (FinOps): Billing mapping doc ready in 2hrs. Will include example invoice JSON and webhook sample.

Zane (SRE): I validated alert thresholds locally. Next step: coordinate a 30-min canary run during deploy window and watch p99. If green, I'll mark alerts as active.

Maya (PM): Action items summary (I'll paste into the signoff doc):
- SLA table agreed: hosted P99 <= 300ms (<=512 tokens), availability >= 99.9% (owner: Maya)
- Alerts + oncall coverage (owner: Zane)
- Canary + smoke script (owner: Priya)
- Billing smoke + quota mapping (owner: Diego)
- Docs runbook + limitations section (owner: Priya)
- Final signoff thread (owner: Maya)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept. If no objections by 18:00 PT, we'll proceed with launch window tomorrow.

Priya (Eng): :thumbsup:

Zane (SRE): :thumbsup:

Diego (FinOps): :thumbsup: will post billing test results here

Maya (PM): Thanks all — I'll create the signoff doc and ping Exec channel when tests pass.
